verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a native way to version, review, or roll back OpenCode automations, whether agents, skills, or GitHub workflows. Skills can be loaded from a repo, so their definitions could be tracked in git. That is a user-side and host-platform workaround, not an OpenCode capability. The plan agent's read-only review covers code changes, not automation definitions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
